This changes the look of the app screens only. Automatic follows the phone: Galaxy in dark mode and Day in light mode. The keyboard theme below is separate.
Some colors were adjusted so the text stays readable.
Animation is paused because battery saver or system animations are off.
This changes how letters look on the keys only. What you type does not change.
Press a key and drag it onto another key to swap them. The space bar and the gaps stay in place.
Press a button and drag it sideways to change its order.

The top line shows long-standing emoji and the bottom line shows recent ones. Under Phone emoji, a phone that is too old for a recent emoji shows an empty square; Noto Color Emoji draws them on every phone.
Emoji are sent as text. The app that receives them draws them with its own font, so they can look different in WhatsApp or Telegram. This style applies only inside the keyboard.
Emoji artwork: Noto Color Emoji by Google, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
No style is active for typing. Press Use on a style to type with it.
Type your own text above to preview it. Screen readers read decorated letters poorly, and some apps may show empty squares. Styles your phone cannot draw are hidden.
When you turn this on, the keyboard saves the text you copy in any app so you can paste it again from the Clipboard button.
What happens to your copied text
Stays on this phone only. Never sent anywhere.
Encrypted with a key kept by Android Keystore.
Recent texts are deleted after 24 hours. Pinned and saved texts stay until you delete them.
Text copied from a password manager that marks it sensitive is never saved.
Nothing is saved while history is off.
Locked sections in the Saved tab need your fingerprint or screen lock. This sets how long they stay open after you confirm.
Delete every recent, pinned and saved text and all sections? This cannot be undone.
The Clipboard button is in the keyboard toolbar. You can move it in Customize. It is hidden in password fields.

Choose how the Translate button in the keyboard works by default. On-device translation sends nothing. AI translation sends the text you chose to our server, only after you agree and tap Translate, and never from password fields.
AI needs your agreement first. Open Translate in the keyboard and read what is sent.
You have not agreed to AI translation.
Withdrawing switches to on-device translation and deletes your install ID. Nothing more is sent.
Models are downloaded from Google when you tap Download. No text of yours is sent. Remove a model to free storage.
Working. This can take a minute.
That did not work. Check your connection and try again.

When you repeat the same slip, for example you press the wrong letter, delete it and type the right one, the keyboard notices and starts fixing it for you. It learns only from what you type, and only on this phone.
1. You type “teh”, delete it and type “the”. You do this a few times.
2. The keyboard notices and learns the fix.
3. Next time you type “teh” and press space, it becomes “the”. Press delete right away to undo.
Swaps a letter you often miss for the one you meant.
Fix the word when I finish it
Fixes a whole word you often retype when you press space, punctuation or Enter. Press delete right after a fix to undo it.
How soon the keyboard starts fixing a slip you repeat. You can undo any fix by pressing delete right after it.
Gentle: fixes only slips you have repeated many times. Fewest fixes and fewest surprises.
Balanced: fixes a slip after you repeat it a few times. Good for most people.
Bold: starts fixing sooner, after fewer repeats. You may see more fixes.
Nothing yet. It learns after you repeat the same slip a few times.
Items marked Active are being fixed now. The others are still being learned. The strongest are shown first.
A line such as “Key A (right) → S” means that when you press the right part of A, you usually mean S.
Delete everything the keyboard has learned from your typing? This cannot be undone.

Everything stays on this phone and nothing is sent anywhere. Nothing is learned or fixed in password fields, and nothing is learned in fields that ask keyboards not to learn. You can delete it all at any time.

Save pictures here and send them from the Images button on the keyboard in any chat or app that accepts images. The pictures are copied into the private storage of this app on this phone only, never uploaded or backed up, and nothing reads them until you tap one on the keyboard. Large pictures are shrunk to save space. GIFs and animated WebP stickers up to 3 MB keep their animation.
Delete every saved image? The originals in your gallery stay.
Vibration and key sounds also follow the Android system settings. Key previews are never shown in password fields.
50% is the standard system vibration. Lower is lighter, higher is stronger. Phones without adjustable vibration keep the standard one.
Show a bubble above the pressed key
Keep the clipboard open after pasting
Arabic-Indic digits in the number row (Arabic and Persian)
Incognito: do not learn words or emoji
Arabic and English are always on. Enable more to add them to the language key.
Type the shortcut then press space to expand it. Not used in password, email or web address fields.
Follow the light or dark mode of the phone
In light mode the keyboard switches to a light theme, and back to a dark one at night. Light themes are easier to read in sunlight.
Smart touch: favour the likely letter next to the one you pressed
Use the keyboard in an attached physical keyboard (Arabic and Persian layouts)
Remember the language for each app
A private Arabic and English keyboard. It works without the internet, and what you type stays on your phone.
Nothing you type is sent anywhere. Translate with AI is the only feature that uses the internet, and only after you agree and tap Translate. Nothing is learned in password fields.

When you turn on any keyboard you add, Android shows a standard warning that a keyboard can see what you type. Nothing you type in Space Keyboard is sent anywhere. Only AI translation uses the internet, and only after you agree and tap Translate.
Turn on Space Keyboard in the list
Choose Space Keyboard as your keyboard
Swipe left on Delete to remove whole words.
Hold a letter to see more characters.
Tap the language key. The language name is shown on the space bar.
Tap the tools button in the top bar for the clipboard, translate, edit and more.
Pick a light or dark theme in Themes.
Choose Space Keyboard first (step 2 of Turn it on) to try it here.
Typing: nothing you type leaves your phone. Learned words, fixes and shortcuts are stored in the private storage of this app only.
Password fields: nothing is learned, suggested, saved to the clipboard history or translated.
Network: only Translate with AI uses the internet, after you agree and tap Translate. On-device translation sends nothing.
Language per app: the keyboard stores the package name of an app next to the language you used there. It stays on this phone. You can turn this off or forget it in Customize.
Backup: a backup file is created only when you ask, and saved where you choose. Learned words are included only if you switch that on. Keep the file private.
You can clear learned words, fixes, images and clipboard data from their screens, or clear the app storage in Android settings to remove everything.

Save your themes, layout and typing choices, shortcuts, remembered app languages, emoji and decoration choices and Learn from my mistakes settings to a file so you can restore them on a new phone. Without a password the file is not encrypted.
Learned words can contain names and private words. Leave this off unless you need them.

Optional. With a password the file is encrypted, so only someone who knows it can open the backup. There is no way to recover a lost password, so keep it somewhere safe. To restore an encrypted file, type its password here first.
Encrypted backup saved. Keep the password safe.
That file is not a valid backup, so nothing was changed.
That file is too large to be a backup.
The file could not be read or written.
This backup is encrypted. Type its password above, then choose the file again.
The password is wrong, so nothing was changed.
The password must be at least 8 characters.
The two passwords are not the same.
Tap the first word to keep exactly what you typed and teach it to the keyboard. Hold a suggestion to remove it.

Choose the Arabic accent that voice typing listens for. English words mixed into Arabic are understood too. Voice typing opens the speech screen of your phone, and the text is inserted when you come back.
Voice typing: the speech is handled by the speech service of your phone, not by this app. This keyboard only receives the text and never records audio.
Switch between Arabic and English automatically

When you open a field that already has text, or tap somewhere else in it, the keyboard looks at the last few letters before the cursor and switches to match. If you change the language yourself, it stops switching in that field. Nothing is stored.
colors background keys glow border animation dark light app look galaxy day eclipse automatic
size height layout language one hand split vibration sound dialect voice suggestions toolbar
restore export import password encrypt file
No settings match. Try another word.

Automatic language: the keyboard reads only the last few letters before the cursor, on the phone, to choose Arabic or English. It does not keep or send them. It does nothing in password fields. You can turn it off in Customize.
